answer: A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own. Getting caught costs the farm a 20% cut on 134589 POA of stakes, and the panel catches farms most of the time. A single trial, a single mark: the trial is Clay digger pearl white proof glazed at the tile kiln, the mark is each pearl white is a firing record witnessed by the kiln master, and the panel accepts nothing else. The whisper opens the gate, the reef pays the toll, the mirror proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay.
